criteria.label: Regulatory Compliance
criteria.description: Understanding and ability to navigate financial regulations
riskIndicators: Operating in regulated space without licenses
fixSuggestions: Research specific licenses required in target market
Start in less regulated product category

criteria.label: Trust & Security
criteria.description: Ability to handle money/data securely and build user trust
riskIndicators: No established brand or track record
Users must trust with sensitive info
fixSuggestions: Start with lower-risk product to build trust

criteria.label: Unit Economics & Funding
criteria.description: Path to profitability or ability to raise capital for growth
fixSuggestions: Explore revenue share or embedded finance
Find niche with higher willingness to pay
Consider B2B fintech (shorter sales, higher value)

criteria.label: Problem-Solution Fit
criteria.description: Clear pain point that existing solutions don't address
fixSuggestions: Solve one specific workflow painfully well

criteria.label: Scalability & Moat
criteria.description: Ability to grow and defend against competition
fixSuggestions: Create deep integrations that increase switching costs
Focus on specific vertical for depth

failurePatterns.description: Users won't trust unknown brand with their money
Requires more capital than founders can access
Banks and established fintechs have unfair advantages
